title: Checkout and Payment Processing Flow
interaction_flow: alt [session null] OrderServlet → Customer: redirect login.jsp?message=Session Expired
CartServiceImpl → DB: SELECT * FROM cart WHERE username=?
alt [cartItems.size() == 0] OrderServiceImpl → OrderServlet: return 'Order Placement Failed!'
TransactionBean → OrderServiceImpl: return transaction (with transactionId, transDateTime)
loop [for each CartBean item in cartItems]
ProductServiceImpl → DB: SELECT price FROM product WHERE pid=?
OrderServiceImpl → OrderBean: new OrderBean(transactionId, item.getProdId(), item.getQuantity(), amount)
OrderServiceImpl → DB: INSERT INTO orders VALUES(transId, prodId, qty, amount, 0)
DB → OrderServiceImpl: return rows affected (k > 0 → ordered=true)
CartServiceImpl → DB: DELETE FROM cart WHERE userid=? AND prodid=?
ProductServiceImpl → DB: UPDATE product SET quantity=quantity-N WHERE pid=?
OrderServiceImpl → DB: INSERT INTO transactions VALUES(transId, userName, transDateTime, transAmount)
DB → OrderServiceImpl: return rows affected → ordered=true
UserServiceImpl → DB: SELECT fname FROM user WHERE username=?
OrderServiceImpl → MailMessage: transactionSuccess(userName, firstName, transactionId, transAmount) [static]
OrderServlet → Customer: render orderDetails.jsp + inject status message via JS
key_relationships: OrderServiceImpl depends_on OrderBean (constructs per cart item)

TransactionBean: TransactionBean(String userName, double transAmount) — calls IDUtil.generateTransId()
MailMessage: transactionSuccess(String recipientEmail, String name, String transId, double transAmount): void [static]
JavaMailUtil: sendMail(String recipient, String subject, String htmlTextMessage): void [static, protected]

important_notes: OrderServlet is @WebServlet('/OrderServlet'); doPost delegates to doGet
Session guard: if username or password null → redirect to login.jsp
paidAmount is parsed from request parameter 'amount' as double
TransactionBean constructor auto-generates transactionId via IDUtil.generateTransId() and sets current Timestamp
addTransaction is called on a NEW instance of OrderServiceImpl (new OrderServiceImpl().addTransaction(...)) — not self, a fresh object
Each cart item: price fetched, OrderBean inserted into 'orders' table, item removed from cart, product stock decremented — all must succeed (any false breaks loop)
Email uses Jakarta Mail (not javax.mail), SMTP gmail:587, STARTTLS; credentials from ResourceBundle 'application.properties'
OrderServlet response: includes orderDetails.jsp then injects status string via inline JS: document.getElementById('message').innerHTML=status
db_tables_accessed: cart (SELECT all by username, DELETE by userid+prodid)
product (SELECT price by pid, UPDATE quantity sold)
orders (INSERT: transid, prodid, qty, amount, shipped=0)
